title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11853__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11853__PART_1_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11853__PART_1_). This Indian Standard ( Part 1 ) which is identical with ISO 8378/1-1986 'Information processing — Data interchange on 130 mm (525 in) flexible disk cartridges using modified frequency modulation recording at 7 958 ftprad 3 8 tpmm ( 96 tpi ) on both sides— Part 1 : Dimensional, physical and magnetic characteristics', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the of the Computers. Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
